import cohere

def cohere_rerank({{api_key}}, {{model}}, {{query}}, {{docs}}, {{top_n}}=5):
    co = cohere.Client({{api_key}})
    r = co.rerank(model={{model}}, query={{query}}, documents={{docs}}, top_n={{top_n}})
    return [({{docs}}[x.index], x.relevance_score) for x in r.results]
